crepe.prep: Lightly butter a non-stick pan and wipe off any excess.
crepe.cook: Pour in about 1/4 cup of batter and swirl the pan to coat it thinly. Cook over medium heat for about {time} per crepe, until the edges lift and the underside is lightly golden, then flip and cook about 30 seconds more.
crepe.check: The crepe should be thin and lightly golden with lacy edges.
notes: The first crepe is a test - adjust the heat after it.
Stack finished crepes on a plate; they will not stick together.

flatbread.prep: Have a dry, heavy skillet ready - no oil is needed.
flatbread.cook: Roll or pat each piece into a round about 3 mm (1/8 in) thick. Cook in the dry pan over medium-high heat for about {time} in total, flipping once, until puffed and browned in spots.
flatbread.check: Both sides should be browned in spots and the flatbread should puff slightly.
notes: Keep the finished flatbreads wrapped in a clean towel so they stay soft.
If the dough sticks to the rolling pin, dust it lightly with flour.

recipes.name: Simple Crepes
recipes.description: Thin, delicate French-style crepes for sweet or savory fillings.

less.note: Crepes use only a little sugar and are usually filled or topped, so you can halve it without any trouble.
expectedChanges: Barely noticeable difference in the crepe

steps.title: Make the Batter
steps.text: Whisk the {L|=flour;=salt;#granulated_sugar|sugar}. Add the {L|#egg|eggs;#milk|milk;=water;@butter|melted butter} and whisk until completely smooth and thin like heavy cream.

steps.title: Rest the Batter
steps.text: Let the batter rest for 20-30 minutes if you have time - it makes the crepes more tender. Thin it with a splash of water if it seems thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fill and fold or roll the warm crepes and serve right away.

tips: A blender makes a perfectly smooth batter in seconds.
Swirl the pan right away - the batter sets quickly.
Crepes freeze well: stack with parchment between each.

recipes.name: Yogurt Flatbread
recipes.description: Soft, pan-cooked flatbreads made with just a few pantry ingredients.

less.note: Only 1 teaspoon of sugar is used, so halving it makes almost no difference.

steps.title: Mix Dry Ingredients
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together the {L|=flour;#baking_powder|baking powder;=salt;#granulated_sugar|sugar}.

steps.title: Add the {^plain_yogurt|Yogurt}
steps.text: Stir in the {#plain_yogurt|yogurt} until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms. Add a spoonful of flour if it is too sticky to handle.

steps.title: Knead and Divide
steps.text: Knead on a floured surface for 1-2 minutes until smooth, then divide into equal pieces (about 4 for every cup of flour) and cover with a towel.

tips: @plain_yogurt: Use thick plain yogurt (Greek-style) for the softest dough.
@butter: Brush the hot flatbreads with garlic butter right away.
@baking_powder: No yeast and no resting time - the baking powder does the work.
